subject: Assigning executive coverage & partial attendance plan for Redwood serving runtime deep-dive
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Amrita Singh <amrita@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Assigning executive coverage & partial attendance plan for Redwood serving runtime deep-dive

Team —

We have the ClearWave architecture deep-dive scheduled for Tuesday, Nov 14 (60–75 min). They specifically asked for an "executive-level presence" during the first 20 minutes for context and to answer business/contract questions. Laura, Rishi — can one of you be the executive sponsor to open the session for the first 20 minutes and handle high-level questions?

Logistics constraints:
- ClearWave prefers 9:00–11:30 PT windows.
- We want the first 20 minutes to be exec-facing (pricing, SLAs, roadmap alignment), then hand off to platform leads for the detailed architecture walkthrough.

Proposed approaches (pick one):
1) Full exec attends first 20m then stays for Q&A (preferred if schedule allows).
2) Exec attends first 20m, then Rishi moderates the rest.
3) Exec joins only for first 20m; Laura moderates and fields any escalation.

Please confirm availability for Nov 14 between 9:00–11:30 PT and which approach you prefer by EOD today — ClearWave needs final confirmation to publish the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product & GTM, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood_arch_agenda_v3.pdf (agenda, 2 pages)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Amrita Singh <amrita@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assigning executive coverage & partial attendance plan for Redwood serving runtime deep-dive

Vivek —

I can take approach #2: I'll open the session as executive sponsor, give the 15–20m framing (business impact, SLAs, high-level architecture), then hand to Rishi for the deep technical review.

Availability: Nov 14 — 9:30–11:30 PT works best for me. If they need a slightly earlier start, I can start at 9:00 but would ask to wrap the exec segment by 9:20.

Action items from me:
- Draft 15m exec slide deck focused on objectives + risk/SLAs (will share by Mon 11/6).
- Confirm attendee list and gatekeepers (please CC any additional Redwood execs who should be invited).

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Assigning executive coverage & partial attendance plan for Redwood serving runtime deep-dive

Hi Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the note. We really value the exec presence for the kickoff. Quick constraints from our side:
- Our CEO has a standing board prep call at 9:00–9:30 PT on Nov 14 and cannot move it.
- Our Head of Infra (internal) can be on the call for the full session.

Given that, can we shift the start to 10:00 PT? If not possible, can the exec-grade framing happen at 10:00 and still be considered the "opening" segment?

We are flexible on the structure as long as a senior Redwood exec is present for the first 15–20 minutes.

Amrita
Amrita Singh
Senior Product Lead, ClearWave
amrita@clearwave.com

[Note: ops@clearwave.com is looped for calendar coordination.]

To: Amrita Singh <amrita@clearwave.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Assigning executive coverage & partial attendance plan for Redwood serving runtime deep-dive

Thanks for the heads-up, Amrita. 10:00 PT is fine — we'll make that the official start. Laura will open the session with a 15m exec framing at 10:00, then hand to Rishi for the architecture walkthrough. Laura, please plan for a 10:00–10:15 exec segment; Rishi, plan for a 10:15–11:15 technical deep-dive.

I've attached the updated agenda and attendee list. Laura will share her 15m slides by Monday (11/13).

Final calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=redwood-clearwave-deepdive (official)
Agenda (preview): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H/view

Attachments: redwood_arch_agenda_v3.pdf (updated), attendee_list.csv

If anyone else needs to join the exec segment, flag now and we'll loop them in.

Vivek
Head of Product & GTM, Redwood Inference
